news.headline: Jaylin Lucas honored by the American Conference
news.summary: The conference put Lucas on its weekly honor roll Monday for his 214 yards and a touchdown against South Alabama. He averaged 19.5 yards a carry, a conference record for a player with at least 10 carries in a game.

news.headline: Tulane wins its home opener 28-24
news.summary: Jaylin Lucas ran for 214 yards, including an 80-yard touchdown. Kadin Semonza threw a 14-yard touchdown pass to Destyn Hill with 1:17 left to put Tulane ahead for good.

news.headline: Tulane wears Mardi Gras uniforms Saturday night
news.summary: Tulane plays South Alabama at home Saturday night in green, purple and gold uniforms made for Mardi Gras. The helmet shows the Angry Wave in a jester hat with beads around it, and the back of the helmet reads "Uptown."

news.headline: Vernell Brown III wins an SEC weekly award
news.summary: The SEC named Brown its co-special teams player of the week on Monday. He returned four punts for 173 yards and two touchdowns against Campbell, the most punt return yards any Florida player has had in a game.

news.headline: Sumrall is not satisfied after the big win
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said he still feels uneasy about his team even after a 52-3 win. Florida starts its conference schedule next Saturday at Auburn.

news.headline: Florida rolls past Campbell 52-3
news.summary: Vernell Brown III ran two punts back for touchdowns, something no Florida player had done in one game since 1996. Jadan Baugh ran for 136 yards and two more scores, and the Gators are 2-0.

news.headline: Arch Manning is the SEC offensive player of the week
news.summary: The SEC gave Manning the award Monday for bringing Texas back from 20 points down against Ohio State. On the three fourth-quarter drives that won the game he threw for 125 yards and a touchdown and ran for 26 more.

news.headline: Texas is the new No. 1 team in the country
news.summary: The Longhorns took over the top spot in the Associated Press poll Sunday after beating Ohio State, with 56 of the first-place votes. It is the first time Texas has been No. 1 during a season since October 2024.

news.headline: Texas beats No. 1 Ohio State 24-23
news.summary: Texas was losing 23-3 in the fourth quarter and scored three touchdowns to win. Hollywood Smothers ran the last one in from the 1-yard line with 25 seconds left.

news.headline: Saints touchdown taken away by replay review
news.summary: Chase Young knocked the ball loose from Jared Goff in the second quarter and Jonas Sanker picked it up and ran it in. Officials looked at the replay and ruled it an incomplete pass instead, so the touchdown did not count.

news.headline: Saints lose in overtime after a 21-point comeback
news.summary: New Orleans was behind 21-0 and came all the way back to tie the game with 1:07 left. In overtime Tyler Shough threw an 8-yard touchdown pass to Noah Fant, but the two-point pass that would have won it fell incomplete and Detroit won 31-30.

news.headline: Chris Olave has the best game of his career
news.summary: Olave caught 10 passes for 182 yards at Detroit, more yards than he has ever had in a game. Tyler Shough threw for 410 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in his first game of the season.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP wins twice in West Virginia
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Shepherd and then Millersville on Friday and did not lose a set in either match. IUP has now won seven in a row and is 8-3.

news.headline: Delaney Concannon wins a conference weekly award
news.summary: Concannon had 49 kills and 52 digs across four wins at IUP's home tournament last weekend. She leads the Crimson Hawks with 105 kills through nine matches.

news.headline: Clarke Schmidt is coming back this week
news.summary: The Yankees will put pitcher Clarke Schmidt back on the roster this week, 14 months after elbow surgery. He will work out of the bullpen and could pitch in the series at Minnesota.

news.headline: Yankees shut out the Mets 2-0
news.summary: Cam Schlittler gave up one hit in six innings Sunday and struck out eight Mets. Ben Rice and Austin Wells each hit a home run, and the Yankees are 86-63.

news.headline: Mets beat the Yankees 12-2 in the Bronx
news.summary: Francisco Lindor hit two home runs and drove in five runs Saturday afternoon at Yankee Stadium. Gerrit Cole gave up five runs in four and a third innings, and the Yankees are now 85-63.
